author: Dana Howl
description:
In this video, I show you my entire process for building and painting up a Protoss Army for the Starcraft Tabletop Miniatures Game. 

Videos Mentioned:
- Starcraft Video Playlist https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLWAt60FHHstY
- Sponging Video https://youtu.be/p1v18olhNBE
- Basing Roller Video https://youtu.be/JGiJuboYvyk

My Website: https://howlcorp.com
Support Me on PATREON: https://patreon.com/danahowl
Starcraft Miniatures Game: https://starcraft-tmg.com

No AI was used in the making of this video. 
Free Product was provided for review purposes by Archon Studio, but they did not pay me to make this video.
